Criteria run viewer

The embedded run-viewer bundle is not present in this build (internal/runstate/viewer/dist holds the placeholder asset). The bundle is built by the castle repo (parapet packages/run-viewer standalone build) and vendored here as a release artifact. The run-state API this viewer consumes is served on the same loopback address:

  • GET /runs, GET /runs/{id}, GET /runs/{id}/events, GET /runs/{id}/inspect
  • GET /agents, GET /health
